notes.title: Art Development Begins for "Swift by Knight"!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44307336/a3b2af3f80d7da2699747b17bb8e78ce40c2a19b.png[/img]
Attention all platformer enthusiasts! [b]Swift by Knight[/b] is taking a bold step into the visual realm with the start of our art development phase. As we explore the vibrant and enchanting world of Swift by Knight, we're experimenting with various art styles that will bring our hand-drawn digital environments and characters to life.

What’s New:

[list]
[*] Character Art Evolution: We're testing different designs for Jack to perfectly capture his agility and spirit. From his armor details to his expressive features, every aspect is being carefully crafted.

[*] Environments Come Alive: We are hard at work creating a series of captivating, hand-drawn settings that Jack will explore. These designs aim to complement the gameplay mechanics uniquely tailored for speed and precision.
[/list]

Sneak Peek:
Don’t miss our included concept art images! They offer a glimpse into the potential looks for Jack and a few other characters and the artistic direction we're considering for the game.

Remember to [b]wishlist[/b] and stay tuned for more updates as we continue to shape the world of "Swift by Knight". Your journey through fast-paced gameplay is about to become even more visually stunning!
